The task did not complete. The verifier still reports the cube out of the slot, and I cannot recover it in this simulator.

**What happened**

- The grasp worked. I opened the jaws, aligned the jaw axis to the cube's 4° yaw, closed at the cube centre, and the sim reported a grasp.
- The place failed on release. I lowered the held cube to a TCP height of about 20 mm over the slot, which put the cube's bottom face below the pocket lip. The xy error was about 1.6 mm against 1 mm of pocket clearance, so the cube caught on the lip and the arm pressed it in. When I released, it tipped and wedged corner-down in the pocket.

**Current state**

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Cube centre | 198.7, -86.1, 19.8 mm |
| Cube tilt | about 44° from flat |
| Distance from slot centre | 8.8 mm (tolerance 3 mm) |
| Arm | at home pose, gripper 50% open |

**Why I could not recover**

- The grasp rule refuses any cube tilted more than 10°, so re-grasping is blocked.
- The gripper fingers do not collide with a free cube in this sim. I swept closed jaws, swept open jaws, pressed a fingertip straight down into the cube, and did a slow face-on push with the jaw pad. None of these moved the cube or produced any joint load. The cube is now completely at rest.

**What would fix a retry**

The sim needs a reset so the cube is flat again. On the next run, release with the cube's bottom face just above the funnel top, which means a TCP height of about 30 mm, with the centre within 2 mm of the slot and the jaw axis checked against the scene before descending. The funnel will then centre the cube on the drop. I was unable to save this as a memory note because the file-writing tools are disabled in this session.
